headline.text: L3 crew cleaned Truffle line without lockout; L2 sorter down awaiting allergen test clearance for Tuesday restart.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel cluster through the weekend shutdown with no line-down events. Maintenance found and addressed minor hardware issues during cleaning—a washer on S2 return conveyor and a missing nut on S2 tunnel. S4 spreading table has a rip noticed during clean.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 sorter failed allergen testing and remains down; level 4 clean will continue Tuesday. ML2 ran bars all day with routine film changes. ML3 held for COA clearance and completed level 2 cleaning, all ATP passed.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 fought demolding problems from 20:10 until overnight—bars sticking, mold exchange actuators releasing stacks, rejected molds piling up. Final refrigerator temp dropped from 56.8 to 53°F; molds stopped rejecting by 06:57. Two safety flags: emergency exit blocked and EEs cleaning Truffle line without lockout.

notes.text: Big Joe #6 battery drains from 100% to 5% in 15 minutes.
ML4 missing about 400 pieces per Nathan's count at 06:37.

resolved.title: Inclusion auger hose dripping into hopper
resolved.summary: Hose pulled tight to connection, dripping liquid pooling near hopper entry point.
resolved.resolution: Chad Stone gave hose slack at 11:57, stopped drip.

resolved.title: Cavanna down 20+ minutes for threading
resolved.summary: Trainees struggled with threading, hopper drained as down time exceeded 20 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Operators completed threading, Cavanna restarted per 20:30 post.

resolved.title: Damaged chocolate pallet with debris
resolved.summary: Pallet damage found, QA inspected and directed scrap of affected pieces.

resolved.title: ML3 level 2 clean and ATP
resolved.summary: Caramel tank, sweco, and line passed all ATP checks after allergen clean.
resolved.resolution: Marlenis confirmed all ATP passed at 21:36.

resolved.title: Plastic bearing fell into chocolate tank
resolved.summary: Bearing from grid removal fell into PTL 2 chocolate during Hershey chip changeover.
resolved.resolution: Crew drained chocolate into bins and recovered the bearing.

resolved.title: ML4 bars sticking to molds, high reject rate
resolved.summary: Demolding failures starting at 20:10, mold exchange actuators releasing stacks, 10 totes of dirty molds by 23:05.
resolved.resolution: Final refrigerator temp lowered from 56.8 to 53°F; demolding improved and molds no longer rejecting as of 06:57.

resolved.title: BOM missing chocolate SKU mid-run
resolved.summary: Buffer tank 1 running low, chocolate not scanning because BOM lacked dual-chocolate percentages.
resolved.resolution: IMS created new WO 43359 with chocolate 10312 at 16:59, line running.

resolved.title: ML4 line down for WO access conflict
resolved.summary: Work order open on another packing computer, blocking access at 00:58.
resolved.resolution: IMS closed WO on floor, all labels uploaded, line back up at 01:11.

resolved.title: ML4 layer 2 & 3 weights out of spec
resolved.summary: Depositor layers 2 and 3 above range during 1st shift capture test at 07:30.
resolved.resolution: Operators and lead adjusted; final bar weight within range by 07:53.

resolved.title: Mold jam in mold exchanger area
resolved.summary: Jam at 08:04, plate popped up on restart putting molds in same direction.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz removed jammed mold and zero-positioned chain; good to go at 08:27, line restarted after 35 minutes.

needs_attention.title: S2 washer found on return conveyor 1
needs_attention.summary: EE found loose washer during inspection; QA notified, maintenance inspecting tunnel 2 section.
needs_attention.status: Under inspection as of 17:46, maintenance checking section.

needs_attention.title: S2 missing washer and nut on tunnel bolt
needs_attention.summary: West side bolt missing washer and nut; nut likely on floor.
needs_attention.status: Found at 18:22, no repair or replacement posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 flow wrap opening up on chocolate contact
needs_attention.summary: Cavanna stopped at 21:08, chocolate causing flow wrap to open up.
needs_attention.status: Stopped for 6 minutes at 21:08, no clear resolution in thread.

needs_attention.title: S3 cooling tunnel 1 broken piece
needs_attention.summary: Component broken, identified by Caleb York during cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 21:21, no replacement or repair follow-up.

needs_attention.title: S4 spreading table has rip
needs_attention.summary: Rip discovered during cleaning; no repair action posted.
needs_attention.status: Noted at 04:00 during shutdown clean, no repair scheduled.

needs_attention.title: Sorter failed allergen ATP, line down
needs_attention.summary: Level 4 clean incomplete; sorter will not restart until allergen testing passes on Tuesday.
needs_attention.status: Down at end of window, clean continues Tuesday per 05:41 post.

needs_attention.title: ML3 held for COA clearance
needs_attention.summary: Bequet written approval received but Kathleen and Aubrey decided to wait for COA before starting.
needs_attention.status: Line held as of 11:05, awaiting COA clearance for Tuesday.

needs_attention.summary: Exit obstructed; Benjamin Hicks flagged for clearance.
needs_attention.status: Blocked as of 22:26, no clearance confirmation.

needs_attention.title: EEs cleaning Truffle line without lockout
needs_attention.summary: Benjamin Hicks observed cleaning crew on energized Truffle equipment.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Phillip, Kimberly, Raoul at 23:00; no lockout or stop confirmation.

needs_attention.summary: Sticker applicator trouble causing accumulation on 2nd shift.
needs_attention.status: Crew working on it at 15:22, no clear resolution posted.
